title: Classic menus
when_to_use: Add, remove, reorder, or relabel items in Appearance → Menus (classic nav menus). Not block-theme wp_navigation.
principles: Read before write: list-menus to pick the menu, then get-menu (or list-menu-items) for the current tree.
ahentic/update-menu items is a full replacement of the item tree. Pass the patched tree (existing items plus the change). Do not invent a from-scratch menu unless they asked to replace or rebuild.
Omit items to leave the tree unchanged (locations-only updates). Omit locations to leave theme assignments unchanged.
Never ahentic/create-post on nav_menu_item. Block theme Navigation blocks / wp_navigation posts are out of scope here - use editor block tools when that document is open.
steps: list-menus (and get-menu for the target) to copy the current nested tree.
Edit that tree in memory: add, remove, reorder, or retitle nodes.
update-menu with menu id plus the full patched items array (HITL). Include locations only if they asked to change theme locations.
Do not also create-post menu items.
anti_patterns: Calling update-menu with a brand-new items list when they asked to add or rename one link.
Skipping get-menu / list-menu-items and guessing the current items.
Treating a block-theme Navigation block as a classic menu.
